mapper.select:
SELECT u.id AS userId, ua.id AS accountId, u.nick_name AS nickName, u.status AS userStatus, ua.account_type AS accountType, ua.account_value AS accountValue, ua.status AS accountStatus, ua.verified AS verifiedStatus, u.created_at AS createdAt, r.id AS roleId, r.name AS roleName FROM t_sys_user u INNER JOIN t_sys_user_account ua ON u.id = ua.user_id AND ua.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN t_sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id AND ur.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN t_sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.is_deleted = 0
u.is_deleted = 0
AND (ua.account_value LIKE CONCAT('%', #{criteria.keyword}, '%') OR u.nick_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{criteria.keyword}, '%'))
AND u.status = #{criteria.status}

SELECT u.id AS userId, ua.id AS accountId, u.nick_name AS nickName, u.status AS userStatus, ua.account_type AS accountType, ua.account_value AS accountValue, ua.status AS accountStatus, ua.verified AS verifiedStatus, u.created_at AS createdAt, r.id AS roleId, r.name AS roleName FROM t_sys_user u INNER JOIN t_sys_user_account ua ON u.id = ua.user_id AND ua.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN t_sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id AND ur.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN t_sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.is_deleted = 0 where u.id = #{userId} AND u.is_deleted = 0 AND (#{accountId} IS NULL OR ua.id = #{accountId})
